title: iDrive reboots and display behavior
summary: This topic centers on iDrive system use and reboot procedures, with positive comments about satisfaction or successful reset guidance, negative comments about unresolved issues and privacy concerns, and many undetermined fragments that only mention reboot steps or use ambiguous 'i drive' wording.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention being pleased with iDrive 8 or describe reboot instructions as a helpful corrective step.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe dissatisfaction with phone content mirroring on the display and cases where rebooting and updates did not resolve the underlying problem.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly record reboot procedures, intermittent screen shutdowns, or ambiguous mentions of 'iDrive' without enough detail to determine sentiment.

limitations: A large share of the sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits clear interpretation of customer sentiment.
Some fragments are too short or ambiguous, including uses of 'i drive' that may not refer to the infotainment system.
The sample mixes customer opinions with service-writer procedural notes about reboot steps, so the topic is partly operational rather than purely evaluative.
Examples are limited for some sentiment categories, so the summary reflects only the supplied fragments.
